# Lokesh Sain — Software Engineer Portfolio
> Fast, accessible, and structured portfolio information for machine and human readers.

Lokesh Sain is a Software Engineer based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, specializing in building responsive web applications with React.js, integrating LLM APIs into product workflows, and architecting scalable full-stack web solutions.

## Featured Projects
- [Apna Backup](https://www.apnabackup.com/): Online backup platform with real-time synchronization and secure cloud file storage. Built with React.js and REST APIs. [Source Code](https://github.com/thelokeshsain/Apna-Backup)
- [FoodCourt Mobile App](https://github.com/thelokeshsain/FoodCourt): Native Android mobile application for cafeteria food ordering and real-time order tracking. Built with Android, Java, and XML.
- [Sizzling Hair Salon Platform](https://github.com/thelokeshsain/Sizzling): Full-stack salon booking and management platform with appointment scheduling. Built with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

## Professional Experience
- **Software Engineer** at 3Handshake Techsoft Private Limited (Jul 2025 – Present) in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Building responsive web applications in React.js and integrating LLM APIs.
- **Web Developer Intern** at 3Handshake Techsoft Private Limited (Jan 2025 – Jul 2025) in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Developed interactive UI components and integrated RESTful APIs.
